description: CA has EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 set, so any enrollable client-auth template becomes SAN-spoofable (ESC1-like).

telemetry.detail: Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services issued a certificate (on the CA). - issued cert carries an attacker-supplied SAN despite the template not allowing it.
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate-logon anomaly.
The EDITF flag plus a SAN that the template did not authorise is a high-fidelity misconfiguration tell.

prerequisite_privilege: Enrollment on any client-auth template published on the misconfigured CA
abuse_primitive: Request a client-auth cert supplying a Domain Admin SAN; the CA honours it due to the EDITF flag.
notes: The vulnerability lives on the CA, not the template, so it applies broadly. Slightly louder than ESC1 because the SAN-vs-template mismatch is unusually clear in CA logs.
